All 8 demo calls

The same four short phone calls, once with an AI-cloned caller and once acted by two group members on a real phone. Every alert below is the unedited log of the live engine. A dashed outline and ✗ mark a wrong alert.

Demo video

One call from each group (AI-cloned or human caller, scam or not), played in real time with the alert sounds. Turn the sound on.

How it works

Two checks run on the same call. The first decides once, in the first seconds, whether the caller's voice is AI-generated. The second reads what is being said and raises SCAM DETECTED as soon as the conversation turns into a scam. Both alerts come with a sound and a full message on the phone screen.

1
Telephone audio. The call (both voices on one track, as a phone records it) is processed at 8 kHz telephone quality (band-pass, μ-law, line noise).
2
AI voice check (once). 5 s after the caller starts speaking, a classifier on frozen WavLM speech features scores the caller's first seconds (4 s windows). If the probability p ≥ 0.8, the phone shows "AI voice detected" with a chime.
3
Scam check (continuous). Whisper (large-v3-turbo) transcribes each sentence as soon as the speaker pauses, and a speaker model (ECAPA) marks it as caller or receiver by voice (the first voice heard is the caller). After every caller sentence a local LLM (Llama 3.1 8B via Ollama) re-reads the whole conversation and returns a scam risk s, the tactics it found and a one-sentence reason.
4
Alerts. An AI voice alone is not a scam (clinics and banks use automated voices), so it only gives a caution. SCAM DETECTED needs scam content; an AI voice lowers the bar.
